newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian govt backs insurers' disaster fund plan.
newsitem.headline: Belgian govt backs insurers' disaster fund plan.

text.p: The Belgian government gave the go-ahead on Friday to the drafting of legislation that will pave the way for commercial insurers to cover natural disasters.

Under the plan, Belgian insurance companies will take over the role played now by the cash-strapped state in providing coverage for victims of floods and other catastrophes. All insurance companies will be obliged to pay into a reinsurance fund for natural disasters, which will place part of its risk on the international market.
Household insurance premiums will also rise by around 134 Belgian francs per million francs of property insured.
